summary: AI-powered online education platform for competitive exam preparation (UPSC, SSC, Railway, Banking, etc.) with AI Teacher, AI Notes Generator, AI Test Generator, AI Exam Strategy Advisor, AI Geography Expert, AI Current Affairs Generator, video lectures, notes, test series, and current affairs
architectural_notes: Multi-page education website with 8 main sections
YouTube video embedding for video classes
PDF download capability for notes and current affairs
Google Form integration for test series
AI-powered chatbot integration (ChatGPT/Gemini) for AI Teacher feature
AI notes generation system with PDF export capability
AI test generation engine for dynamic quiz/test creation
AI Geography Expert module with diagram and map generation

existing_features.title: Create a Home page displaying academy logo, tagline 'Ek Kadam Nishulk Shiksha Ki Aur', courses list preview, latest updates section, Join WhatsApp button, YouTube channel link, and About Founder section featuring Gyanendra Singh

Create a Courses section organizing competitive exams into categories: UPSC, UPPCS, SSC, Railway, Banking, TET/CTET, Police, NDA/CDS, and University Geography. Each exam category must display syllabus, video lectures, notes, previous year questions (PYQ), and test series
Create a Video Classes page with embedded YouTube videos organized by subject categories: Geography Classes, Current Affairs, GS Classes, and Exam Strategy
Create a Notes section where students can browse and download PDF notes organized by subjects: History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, and Current Affairs
Create a Test Series section offering three types of assessments: Daily Quiz, Weekly Test, and Full Length Test
Create a Current Affairs section with three content types: Daily Current Affairs updates, Weekly PDF downloads, and Monthly Magazine downloads

Create an About Us page describing SinghGyanAcademy as an educational platform with the mission to provide free education to students from low and middle-income families, and featuring founder Gyanendra Singh
Create a Contact page displaying mobile number, email address, and a WhatsApp button for direct communication
Implement student registration functionality allowing users to create accounts on the platform
Create an admin interface for managing platform content including courses, video lectures, notes, test series, and current affairs updates

Apply a cohesive, educational design theme throughout the platform that conveys trust, accessibility, and professionalism suitable for a free education initiative serving competitive exam aspirants. Use warm, inviting colors that promote learning, clear typography for readability, and an organized layout that makes content easy to navigate

Create an AI Learning Zone page accessible from the main navigation that serves as the central hub for all AI-powered features, displaying sections for Ask AI Teacher, Generate Notes, Create Test, Exam Strategy, and Doubt Solver

Implement an AI Teacher chatbot interface that allows students to ask questions about Geography, UPSC preparation, Polity notes, and other academic topics, providing instant responses in a conversational format available 24/7

Build an AI Notes Generator feature that accepts student requests for subject-specific notes (e.g., 'मुझे Indian Polity Notes चाहिए'), generates structured notes with key concepts, creates downloadable PDF files, and provides revision points
Create an AI Test Generator that automatically creates MCQ tests, practice questions, mock tests, and PYQ pattern assessments based on selected topics or exam categories
Implement an AI Exam Strategy Advisor that provides personalized study plans, book recommendations, and time tables when students ask questions like 'SSC की तैयारी कैसे करें?'
Build an AI Geography Expert feature specifically designed for geography education that generates diagrams, maps, detailed notes, concept explanations, and university-level content when requested
Create an AI Current Affairs Generator that produces daily current affairs updates, generates quizzes based on recent events, and compiles monthly PDF summaries automatically
Update the home page hero section to prominently display the tagline '🎓 India's Smart AI Learning Platform' above the existing 'Ek Kadam Nishulk Shiksha Ki Aur' tagline

Add a prominent feature showcase section on the home page highlighting the AI-powered capabilities (AI Teacher, Notes Generator, Test Generator, Strategy Advisor, Geography Expert, Current Affairs Generator) with icons and brief descriptions
Update the Contact page to display mobile number 7068728031 instead of any existing contact number

Create an admin dashboard landing page that displays navigation cards for managing courses, videos, notes, tests, current affairs, branding (logo/colors), and viewing registered students. Include statistics overview showing total counts for each content type.

Enhance the existing ManageCourses admin page to support editing and deleting courses in addition to adding new courses. Display a list of all existing courses with edit and delete buttons for each course.

Create a video management admin page where admins can add YouTube video links with metadata (title, category, description), edit existing videos, and delete videos. Display all videos in a searchable and filterable list.

Enhance the existing ManageTests admin page to support editing and deleting test series. Display a list of all existing tests with edit and delete buttons, and allow admins to modify questions within a test.
Enhance the existing ManageNotes admin page to support editing and deleting notes. Display a list of all uploaded notes with subject, title, and action buttons for each note.

Enhance the existing ManageCurrentAffairs admin page to support editing and deleting current affairs entries. Display a list of all current affairs posts with type (daily/weekly/monthly), date, and action buttons.
Create a branding settings admin page where admins can upload a new logo image, preview it, and update the logo used throughout the platform. Store the logo as a generated image asset.
Create a student management admin page that displays a searchable and filterable table of all registered students showing name, email, registration date, and activity status.

Update the Navigation component to dynamically load and display the logo from backend configuration instead of using a hardcoded path, allowing logo changes from the branding settings page to reflect immediately.
